Hands.name: Acidic Claws

specialEffects: On Hit: Deal protection-ignoring Acid damage equal to 5+UL, but reduces the weapon's durability by 1.
Hands.flavour: Coated in powerful acid, hitting your foes up close will splash some of it on them. And probably on your weapon, too, unfortunately.

Hands.name: Archery Gloves
Hands.details: +2 SKI +2 Power to Bow Weapons (Basic attacks only.)
specialEffects: +2 Power to Bow Weapons (Basic attacks only.)
Hands.flavour: A set of gloves made for archery. You don't have to use them for archery, though.

Hands.name: Ash-Kissed Malas
Hands.details: +2 STR Grants Skill: Goren Bakudan 3M, 15 FP, 1 Round CD Kenpo. Create an explosion from your fist in close proximity to an enemy within 1 Range, dealing damage split between Fire and your Fist's damage type to all enemies in 2 Range of them (+1 Range per Fire Mark). If the initial target is Grappled, the damage they take has Great Accuracy. Furinkazan: Gain 1 Fire Mark.

Hands.flavour: Gently tickled by ashes and incense, these prayer beads are worn around the wrist in certain cultures. Hopefully their prayers won't be for you.

Hands.flavour: A pair of cloth bands which raise the focus of the wearer, making them popular amongst magicians and martial artists.

Hands.name: Bands of the Boar
Hands.details: +1-4 STR
Hands.flavour: As a colleague of both Aretia Lutga and Caren Korough, the card magician Nicoli Dumata created these bands to make a statement to the both of them. While the bands make the person who wears them stronger, it was a message to the two about how pig-headed they were handling their rivalry. Still, they eventually became popular amongst adventurers.

Hands.name: Bands of the Cat
Hands.details: +1-4 CEL
Hands.flavour: Made as an experiment by the well-known Grimalkin enchanter Aretia Lutga, these bands increase the wearer's agility, making them more cat-like. Eventually, due to popularity, many were produced, and it spawned several similar styles.

Hands.name: Bands of the Centaur
Hands.details: +1-3 SKI Increases Move by 1.
Hands.flavour: Seemingly inspired by Aretia Lutga's work, the magical beast biologist Kalnal Sulet created these wristbands, giving it properties of the elusive centaur.

Hands.name: Bands of the Chimera
Hands.details: +1 to all stats. Also treated as 'Beast' race type.
Hands.flavour: A special set of fused wristbands. They give a variety of bonuses, but also give off the aura of a beast.

Hands.name: Bands of the Crocodile
Hands.details: +1-3 WIL, +1-2 DEF
Hands.flavour: A collaboration between 'Fist Mage' Nen Grander and magical beast biologist Kalnal Sulet. These wristbands grant the perceived properties of the crocodile's intelligence, as noted by Kalnal, and its toughness, as testified by Nen, saying it was the third hardest thing he's ever punched.

Hands.name: Bands of the Hawk
Hands.details: +1-4 SKI
Hands.flavour: Aretia Lutga's long-time rival as one of the few Kaelensia mages, Caren Korough, created these bands after seeing what Aretia's Bands of the Cat were capable of. Though, these bands, which grant superior eye-sight and accuracy, are made more in the image of Caren's ancestors than her rival's.

Hands.name: Bands of the Wyvern
Hands.details: +1-4 VIT
Hands.flavour: After Aretia Lutga's 'Bands of the Cat' became popular, many similar bands were created by Karaten mages. 'Fist Mage' Nen Grander's spin were these fortitude-increasing bands, with the creator saying that the hardest thing he'd ever hit was a wyvern.

Hands.name: Bloody Palms
Hands.details: On Deal Damage: If physical, inflicts Claret Call LV UL for 2 rounds. If magic, inflicts Hunted LV UL for 2 rounds. Then, your opponent applies the same status to you at half that LV, for 2 rounds.
specialEffects: On Deal Damage: If physical, inflicts Claret Call LV UL for 2 rounds. If magic, inflicts Hunted LV UL for 2 rounds. Then, your opponent applies the same status to you at half that LV, for 2 rounds.
Hands.flavour: Why won't the blood come off?

Hands.name: Blue Ki Controllers
Hands.details: Increases Experience Points gained by 10%. +1 STR, +1 VIT Caps HP damage taken by Ki Awoken at 10% of your maximum HP, but lowers its LV by 2 (min. 1). Hands.flavour: A pair of weighted, blue beaded-wristbands which help manage your ki from going out of control.

Hands.name: Bradan Glove
Hands.details: Increases Hit by 5. Grants Skill: Lick Thumb 2 Momentum, 30 FP, 5 Round Cooldown Lick the thumb of the Bradan Glove, granting you incredible insight for a brief moment. Grants +50 Critical for 1 attack this round, and reduces the LV of any Burn status affecting you by 10.
specialEffects: Lick the thumb of the Bradan Glove, granting you incredible insight for a brief moment. Grants +50 Critical for 1 attack this round, and reduces the LV of any Burn status affecting you by 10.
Hands.flavour: A glove made out of salmon scales with a red thumb. It is nimble and flexible, but some say that licking your thumb while wearing it briefly grants god-like senses.

Hands.name: Burning Bracers
Hands.details: Suffer 2 Fire magic damage every round. (Ignores resistances.) On Hit: If a Fist weapon, deals 15 Fire armor-ignoring magic damage.
specialEffects: Suffer 2 Fire magic damage every round. (Ignores resistances.)
On Hit: If a Fist weapon, deals 15 Fire armor-ignoring magic damage.
Hands.flavour: An enchanted pair of bracers that burn the wearer, but imbues their strikes with the element of fire.

Hands.name: Chunin Gloves
Hands.details: +1 CEL, +1 STR
Hands.flavour: The gloves of a NINJA! Strike swiftly, strike hard!

Hands.name: Chunin Gloves Plus
Hands.details: +2 CEL If you have a Shuriken equipped: Movement type becomes Teleport. +5 Hit to Shuriken Weapons
specialEffects: If you have a Shuriken equipped: Movement type becomes Teleport.
Hands.flavour: The gloves of a NINJA! Strike swiftly, strike hard! Enhanced by a magical power.

Hands.name: Conversion Gloves
Hands.details: When you take any Lightning damage, activate Weapon Autocharge. (Weapon Autocharge has a 1 round CD shared with all effects that activate it.)
specialEffects: When you take any Lightning damage, activate Weapon Autocharge. (Weapon Autocharge has a 1 round CD shared with all effects that activate it.)
Hands.flavour: A pair of mechanical gloves that are designed to interface with weapons along the same type of the Excel series. Which means if you don't have one of those weapons, they probably aren't useful to you.

Hands.name: Crownbleeder
Hands.details: +2 STR When you bring a target below 25% HP, inflicts them with Fear for 1 turn.
specialEffects: When you bring a target below 25% HP, inflicts them with Fear for 1 turn.
Hands.flavour: An enchanted set of gauntlets said to be covered in the blood of royalty.

Hands.name: Crownbleeder Plus
Hands.details: +3 STR +5% Critical Chance When you bring a target below 50% HP, inflicts them with Fear for 4 turns.
specialEffects: When you bring a target below 50% HP, inflicts them with Fear for 4 turns.
Hands.flavour: An enchanted set of gauntlets said to be covered in the blood of royalty. Enhanced by a magical power.

Hands.name: Dazzling Glove
Hands.details: Dealing Lightning damage to an enemy has a chance to inflict Spelldaze on them for 2 rounds. (Chance = 50% of Damage Dealt)
specialEffects: Dealing Lightning damage to an enemy has a chance to inflict Spelldaze on them for 2 rounds. (Chance = 50% of Damage Dealt)
Hands.flavour: A pair of magical gloves. They shine in a stunning way when exposed to intense light.

Hands.name: Dew-Drenched Charm
Hands.details: +2 VIT Grants Skill: Kaiyo Hosshin 3M, 15 FP, 1 Round CD Kenpo. Manifest a clone of water that performs a basic attack with your Fist weapon on a target within 12 Range (with no Farshot Penalty), dealing Water damage. In order to do so, the target must be within 1 Range of a water-based field tile, or Soaked. Furinkazan: Gain 1 Forest Mark.
specialEffects: Kenpo. Manifest a clone of water that performs a basic attack with your Fist weapon on a target within 12 Range (with no Farshot Penalty), dealing Water damage. In order to do so, the target must be within 1 Range of a water-based field tile, or Soaked.
Hands.flavour: A seemingly normal, harmless charm, if a little moist from morning dew. But even that dew can be a weapon in the right hands.

Hands.name: Dragon King Gauntlet
Hands.details: Set: Dragon King Increases total Strength by 5% and soft cap for Strength by 3 for each Dragon King item equipped.
specialEffects: Increases total Strength by 5% and soft cap for Strength by 3 for each Dragon King item equipped.
Hands.flavour: Part of a set of armor once worn by a man with dragonblood. Its power causes the strength of the wearer to increase.

Hands.name: Ghosthand
Hands.details: +2 CEL You do not trigger enemy effects that activate when you attack them.
specialEffects: You do not trigger enemy effects that activate when you attack them.
Hands.flavour: Covers your hands in some sort of ectoplasmic cloth.

Hands.name: Green Gloves
Hands.details: Increases Experience Points gained by 10%. Set: Unassuming Adventurer 2+: Flee success rate is (normal success rate+50)%. 3+: +(10 x total number of this set's item equipped) HP and FP. 5+: +15% damage dealt.
specialEffects: 2+: Flee success rate is (normal success rate+50)%.
3+: +(10 x total number of this set's item equipped) HP and FP.
Hands.flavour: A pair of gloves meant for beginners to hard work.

Hands.name: Harp Plucker's Gloves
Hands.details: +5 Sound ATK Increases Hit by 5 for Instrument weapons. Reduces the FP cost of Song skills by 10%. (Applied as an Efficiency effect; doesn't stack with other Efficiency reductions.)
specialEffects: Increases Hit by 5 for Instrument weapons.
Reduces the FP cost of Song skills by 10%. (Applied as an Efficiency effect; doesn't stack with other Efficiency reductions.)
Hands.flavour: A decorated pair of gloves that are meant to help take the pain out of playing the harp, or other instruments.

Hands.name: Hulking Hands
Hands.details: +4 STR Increases Hit by 5 for Fist weapons. +5% Success to Grapple attempts.
specialEffects: Increases Hit by 5 for Fist weapons.
Hands.flavour: Your enemies won't like that you're angry while you're wearing these.

Hands.name: Indignant Idol
Hands.details: -10% Light Resistance -10% Elemental Resistance to enemies when dealing damage from a Spell. (Doubled versus monsters.)
specialEffects: -10% Elemental Resistance to enemies when dealing damage from a Spell. (Doubled versus monsters.)
Hands.flavour: This wooden carved idol is infused with a paranormal power that allows it to penetrate magical defenses.

Hands.name: Insulated Burning Bracers
Hands.details: On Hit: If a Fist weapon, deals 15 Fire armor-ignoring magic damage.
specialEffects: On Hit: If a Fist weapon, deals 15 Fire armor-ignoring magic damage.
Hands.flavour: An enchanted pair of bracers that burn the wearer, but imbues their strikes with the element of fire. These ones are insulated with bird feathers, so they don't burn your arms. Neat.

Hands.name: Ivy Binds
Hands.details: Successfully using Grapple on an enemy inflicts them with Slow LV2 (2 rounds) and deals protection-ignoring Earth magic bonus damage equal to 50% of your Earth ATK. Enemies who are standing on a plant tile are treated as Plant racial type for your effects.
specialEffects: Successfully using Grapple on an enemy inflicts them with Slow LV2 (2 rounds) and deals protection-ignoring Earth magic bonus damage equal to 50% of your Earth ATK. Enemies who are standing on a plant tile are treated as Plant racial type for your effects.
Hands.flavour: A large, living seed that wraps itself around the wearer's hand. It almost seems to have a will of its own.

Hands.name: Magic Gauntlet
Hands.details: Grants Skill: Magic Shield 3 Momentum, 5 FP Charges your gauntlet with focus, creating a shield of energy that increases your DEF and RES by 4 for 4 rounds. This will also end other effects caused by the Magical Gauntlet.
specialEffects: Charges your gauntlet with focus, creating a shield of energy that increases your DEF and RES by 4 for 4 rounds. This will also end other effects caused by the Magical Gauntlet.
Hands.flavour: A light-weight gauntlet enchanted with some sort of artifact that generates a protective barrier.

Hands.name: Metal Gauntlet
Hands.details: +2 Armor
Hands.flavour: A gauntlet which is designed to protect your arm and hand in the midst of close combat.

Hands.name: Metal Gauntlet Plus
Hands.details: +5 Armor +10 Critical Evade versus melee range enemies who are not directly behind you.
specialEffects: +10 Critical Evade versus melee range enemies who are not directly behind you.
Hands.flavour: A gauntlet which is designed to protect your arm and hand in the midst of close combat. Enhanced by a magical power.

Hands.name: Nihilist
Hands.details: Ignores elemental absorption possessed by enemies and the equipped character.
specialEffects: Ignores elemental absorption possessed by enemies and the equipped character.
Hands.flavour: A set of cursed gloves that represent futility for both the user and their foes.

Hands.name: Ninja Kote

You jump with your grappled target into the air, then fall down, slamming them head-first into the ground, dealing Blunt physical damage that can critically hit (equal to 100% of SWA of your weapon), and knocking them away 3 tiles. If the damage was a critical hit, there is also a status-infliction based chance they'll be Knocked Down. Damage inflicted by this skill cannot be parried, nor evaded.

Hands.flavour: A pair of thinly-armored armbands used by ninjas. The small spikes in the wrists help with climbing and holding onto unsuspecting prey.

Hands.name: Nullstone Gauntlet
Hands.details: +10 HP -10% Magic Damage Taken.
Hands.flavour: Made from an anti-magic material called Nullstone, this gauntlet protects from magic, as you'd expect.

Hands.name: Rogue's Work Gloves
Hands.details: +10% Critical Damage +2 Power if attacking an enemy from behind.
specialEffects: +2 Power if attacking an enemy from behind.
Hands.flavour: For showing enemies your stabs.

Hands.name: Salamander's Skin
Hands.details: Doubles the damage taken from Burn statuses, but negates additional effect(s) caused by them.
specialEffects: Doubles the damage taken from Burn statuses, but negates additional effect(s) caused by them.
Hands.flavour: These gloves are warm to the touch, and when they're even hotter, it seems like they make you tougher. At the cost of being even hotter. Just like a salamander.

Hands.name: Sanctifying Hand Lantern
Hands.details: +3 FAI Prevents most special effect tiles from being created at your location by enemies.
specialEffects: Prevents most special effect tiles from being created at your location by enemies.
Hands.flavour: A blessed lantern meant to be carried in one's hand.

Hands.name: Sand-Polished Band
Hands.details: +2 DEF Grants Skill: Riseki Yoroi 3M, 15 FP, 1 Round CD Kenpo. Targets 1 enemy in 1 Range (or 1 enemy you have Magnetized in 3 Range, who is pulled to you) and performs a shattering fist strike, dealing damage split between Earth and your Fist's damage type. If it hits, the target is inflicted with Wear Down (LV 10, 2 rounds). Furinkazan: Gain 1 Mountain Mark.
specialEffects: Kenpo. Targets 1 enemy in 1 Range (or 1 enemy you have Magnetized in 3 Range, who is pulled to you) and performs a shattering fist strike, dealing damage split between Earth and your Fist's damage type. If it hits, the target is inflicted with Wear Down (LV 10, 2 rounds).
Hands.flavour: A metal wristband smoothed by countless desert winds. Not all who stand up to the buffeting storm come out looking so lovely.

Hands.name: Sayakensa
Hands.details: +10% Critical Chance -2 VIT Boosts Kensei skill damage by +10 and turns their damage into Dark if Katana is cursed.
specialEffects: Boosts Kensei skill damage by +10 and turns their damage into Dark if Katana is cursed.
Hands.flavour: As an object bathed in shadow for so long, this sheath has been forever tainted by its curse.

Hands.name: Shifty Pocket
Hands.details: +2 CEL, +2 GUI On Battle Start: If you have a Magic Pocket enchantment on an equipped item, gain Hand On Weapon. Hands.flavour: Keep your hand in your pocket, and your eyes on the streets. You never know when you're gonna need to draw.

Hands.name: Spy Wristwatch

specialEffects: Fires a small dart at a target, inflicting 5 unresistable Pierce damage and LV1 Poison for 3 Rounds without fail (unless they're immune to it, of course.)
Hands.flavour: One second you're checking your watch... the other, your enemy is on the floor, choking to death. Well, maybe not.

Hands.name: Tetra Gauntlet
Hands.details: +10% Fire Resistance (Tetra) +10% Status Resist versus Burn. (Tetra) (Tetra items can have their properties swapped between Fire & Burn, Ice & Frostbite, Earth & Poison and Wind & Confusion at the respective Crystals around Korvara.)
specialEffects: (Tetra items can have their properties swapped between Fire & Burn, Ice & Frostbite, Earth & Poison and Wind & Confusion at the respective Crystals around Korvara.)
Hands.flavour: A magical gauntlet attuned with nature. If one had the opportunity and knowledge, it could resonate with powerful elemental forces, and change its own.

Hands.name: Titan's Gauntlet
Hands.details: For the purposes of Battle Weight, your equipped weapon has 0 Weight.
specialEffects: For the purposes of Battle Weight, your equipped weapon has 0 Weight.
Hands.flavour: A single gauntlet enchanted with great strength, allowing its wearer to wield greatswords as if they were butter knives.

Hands.name: Weaponmaster's Glove

specialEffects: Increases the trigger rate and bonus trigger rate for your Special Strikes by 25% of their original values.
2+ - Decreases the cooldown of Special Strikes by 1 round. (Min. 1 round)
Hands.flavour: A light glove that resonates with the weapons it holds, bringing out its full potential.

specialEffects: Reduces damage from Beast race enemies by 10%.
Shield.flavour: A shield with a grudge towards beasts.

specialEffects: Reduces damage from Beast race enemies by 15%.
Increases status resistance versus Beast race enemies by 15%.

Shield.name: Beldam Aegis
Shield.details: +2 DEF 10-30% Lightning Resistance
Shield.flavour: An enchanted shield used by Beldam Knights traditionally. It wards off the deadly grip of lightning.

Shield.name: Blue Iron Shield
Shield.details: +3 DEF 10-30% Darkness Resistance
Shield.flavour: Iron bathed in pure blue flames; it wards off the power of darkness. It can also be used to make an iron blue indention in an enemy's face.

Shield.name: Brightray Bulwark
Shield.details: +2 DEF 50% Darkness Retaliation
Shield.flavour: A bright, glowing shield. Its reflective light returns the darkness to its owner.

Shield.name: Fang-Faced Shield

Shield.flavour: A gruesome combination of offense and defense that shows the duality of life. You will be very happy to be on one side of this shield, while others will not be pleased at all to be on the other side. Especially if it's piercing their face.

specialEffects: Reduces damage from Fireblood race enemies by 10%.

Shield.name: Fossil Shield

Shield.flavour: This is more like a giant piece of bone from a fossil than a shield, but if the shape fits...

Shield.name: Hero's Shield

specialEffects: On Battle Start: If you have at least 40 base DEF, gain Debuff Immunity LV1 permanently.
Shield.flavour: This brilliant shield, with its fine engravings and golden finish, is something right out of a storybook where the hero does battle with fierce monsters.

Shield.name: Lion Shield

specialEffects: Unleash a mighty roar. Increases the user's STR by 2 (+1 per 5 character levels) for 3 rounds. Enemies in range may also be Feared for 2 rounds.

Shield.flavour: Similar to a tortoise shell, this shield is made of magnetic metals that can be enhanced during brief moments. It will draw in certain attacks towards it.

Shield.name: Metal Buckler

specialEffects: +2 Power to Unarmed Weapons (Basic attacks only.)

Shield.name: Metal Shield

Shield.name: Moon-Mirror Shield
Shield.details: +2 RES 50% Light Retaliation
